paper_id: High-Frequency Artifacts-Resistant Image Watermarking Applicable to Image Processing Models
title: High-Frequency Artifacts-Resistant Image Watermarking Applicable to Image Processing Models
motivation: 生成模型版权保护日益重要，但现有水印方法在频域产生高频伪影，威胁隐蔽性与安全性
problem_framing: 将图像水印的频域可见性问题形式化为CNN嵌入网络固有缺陷与扰动叠加导致的高频伪影问题
key_insight: 绕过CNN嵌入网络，直接在低频域嵌入可调频率扰动，可同时规避CNN结构伪影与扰动引入的高频痕迹
method_signature: 频率扰动生成网络F替代CNN嵌入器，低频域(128×128)叠加扰动，联合训练提取网络E
evaluation_criteria: 频域不可见性(FP/LPIPS)、空域质量(PSNR>50dB)、提取成功率(100%)、鲁棒性
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 对加性噪声攻击存在脆弱性，无法预测并防御所有潜在攻击策略
evidence_for_taste: our approach diverges from the traditional reliance on CNNs
minimizes the impact of the watermark embedding process on the high-frequency attributes
enhance the covertness of the watermark
our framework shows some vulnerability against additive noise attacks
thinking_moves: 从频谱分析发现现有方法的核心缺陷
将CNN结构固有缺陷与水印嵌入过程缺陷解耦分析
将问题从空间域隐蔽性重新框架为频域隐蔽性
通过替换架构根本性地解决高频伪影问题
cites_own_work: Zhang, J.; Chen, D.; Liao, J.; Zhang, W.; Feng, H.; Hua, G.; Yu, N. Deep Model Intellectual Property Protection
